title: Walking Tour of Granada
text: I organized this tour for my mother and me because we didn’t have much time in Granada, so I wanted us to do a longer tour to see the city center, Albaicín and Sacromonte. This was perfect. Our tour guide, Marco, was truly fantastic. He came and met us at our hotel and was fully of energy and excitement to show us his city. He was really knowledgeable about the history, took us to important sites, but also interspersed it with beautiful viewpoints and gardens and his favorite little streets that he had discovered over the years.
